rules: 1. publishesIn(X, Y) :- researchesTopic(X, Z), publishesIn(Z, Y)
2. publishesIn(X, Y) :- collaboratesWith(X, Z), publishesIn(Z, Y)
3. publishesIn(X, Y) :- attendsConference(X, Z), publishesIn(Z, Y)
4. publishesIn(X, Y) :- hasResearchGrant(X, Z), publishesIn(Z, Y)
5. publishesIn(X, Y) :- isAdvisedBy(X, Z), publishesIn(Z, Y)
